changelog: v0.8.2: 1) Immersive Focus Void Mode: Added empty immersive 3D view eliminating avatar, 3D space environment, and background music into a pure black void, leaving only the floating 3D interactive HUD panel; 2) Automatic Live Mode Activation: Entering Focus Void Mode automatically activates hands-free Live Mode; 3) Full State Snapshot & Exact Restoration: Exiting Focus Mode cleans up void state and restores pre-entry state exactly (avatar visibility, active 3D space environment, background music state, and Live Mode on/off state); 4) In-VR 3D Panel Minimize & Reopen: Added ➖ Hide Panel button in 3D console header to collapse the HUD into a compact floating 👁️ Reopen Panel pill, providing unobstructed scene visibility; 5) Quest 3 Left Stick & Android Touch Locomotion: Enabled direct avatar locomotion via Quest 3 Left Thumbstick (axes[0]/axes[1]) and Android 2-finger touch drag.
